bucketMeaning.in-file-unique: resolves in this file, one symbol
bucketMeaning.in-file-ambiguous-disambiguated: >1 symbol, but exactly ONE matches the kind the relationship type implies
bucketMeaning.in-file-ambiguous-residual: >1 symbol and NOT disambiguated by kind — a genuine collision
bucketMeaning.foreign-ccall: a C symbol, so by the file's own declaration (isForeignCall)
bucketMeaning.external-by-import: qualified root is imported by THIS file (tree-read import path)
bucketMeaning.corpus-only: declared in another file of this corpus
bucketMeaning.local-binding: bound in this file and NOT published — a parameter/loop/let/catch binding
bucketMeaning.unresolvable: resolves to nothing — external package, dynamic dispatch, or a lost declaration
bucketMeaning.synthetic-scope: synthetic scope name (global/root), not a symbol
